cards.answer: Renata Glasc is a support mage who shields and empowers allies, delays their deaths, and makes enemies attack their allies. Her Q and E deal magic damage and scale with AP.
cards.counterplay: Dodge her crowd control, spread out against her ultimate, and deny takedowns to allies protected by Bailout.

citations.quote: Name: Renata Glasc. Official role tags: Support, Mage.

facts.claim: Renata Glasc is a support mage

citations.quote: Renata and allies struck are granted a shield
Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death
Berserk causes the target to prioritize attacking their allies over their enemies.

facts.claim: shields and empowers allies, delays their deaths, and makes enemies attack their allies.

cards.priority_reason: Summarizes her ally protection and fight-turning crowd control.

cards.answer: Her attacks mark enemies, dealing bonus magic damage based on maximum health when the target is unmarked. An allied champion's damaging attack or ability consumes the mark for additional maximum-health-based magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Limit trades where Renata and her ally can repeatedly hit you together.

citations.quote: Renata's basic attacks apply a mark that lasts a few seconds and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

facts.claim: Her attacks mark enemies, dealing bonus magic damage based on maximum health when the target is unmarked.

citations.quote: Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

facts.claim: An allied champion's damaging attack or ability consumes the mark for additional maximum-health-based magic damage.

cards.priority_reason: Explains the extra damage from coordinated trades.

cards.answer: Handshake damages and roots the first enemy hit. Renata can recast during the root to throw that target, damaging enemies in its path; throwing a champion also stuns secondary targets hit.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the hook and keep clear of a hooked teammate's potential throw path.

citations.quote: Renata fires a hook in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and briefly roots them.

facts.claim: Handshake damages and roots the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: She can recast the ability while the target is rooted.
Renata breaks the tether to knock the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through.
If the thrown target is a champion, all secondary targets hit are stunned for 0.5 seconds.

facts.claim: Renata can recast during the root to throw that target, damaging enemies in its path; throwing a champion also stuns secondary targets hit.

cards.priority_reason: Her root and throw can catch enemies and disrupt grouped teammates.

cards.answer: Bailout grants Renata or an allied champion increasing attack speed and movement speed toward enemies; champion takedowns refresh its duration. Fatal damage instead restores their health to full and starts a lethal burn. A qualifying champion takedown stops the burn and leaves them at low health.
cards.counterplay: Disengage from the empowered target and protect vulnerable teammates to deny a saving takedown.

citations.quote: Renata grants herself or the target allied champion ramping bonus attack speed in addition to bonus movement speed toward enemies. Bailout's duration resets whenever the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion.

facts.claim: Bailout grants Renata or an allied champion increasing attack speed and movement speed toward enemies; champion takedowns refresh its duration.

citations.quote: If the target would die while Bailout is active, their health is set back to full but they suffer a true damage burn that would kill them over a short time.

facts.claim: Fatal damage instead restores their health to full and starts a lethal burn.

citations.quote: The burn will stop once the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their current health to 20% of their maximum health immediately afterwards.

facts.claim: A qualifying champion takedown stops the burn and leaves them at low health.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing delayed death and the saving takedown condition changes target selection.

cards.answer: Loyalty Program strikes around Renata, along its missile path, and at its explosion. It shields Renata and allies hit while dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the missile path and its destination; account for shields when trading into her allies.

citations.quote: Renata sends out chemtech rockets from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her.
striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching the target location.

facts.claim: Loyalty Program strikes around Renata, along its missile path, and at its explosion.

citations.quote: Renata and allies struck are granted a shield, and enemies struck are dealt magic damage and slowed for a short time.

facts.claim: It shields Renata and allies hit while dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit.

cards.priority_reason: Her main trading tool combines enemy damage with allied protection.

cards.answer: Hostile Takeover sends a chemical wave that makes enemy champions and minions hit go berserk and gain attack speed. They prioritize attacking their own allied champions, then other allied units, before enemies.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the wave's path and spread away from teammates, especially allied attackers.

citations.quote: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.
Enemy champions and minions hit briefly become berserk, gaining bonus attack speed.

facts.claim: Hostile Takeover sends a chemical wave that makes enemy champions and minions hit go berserk and gain attack speed.

citations.quote:
Within their targeting radius, they prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order:
Their allied champions
Allied non-champions
Allied wards
Enemy units (including monsters)

facts.claim: They prioritize attacking their own allied champions, then other allied units, before enemies.

cards.priority_reason: Berserk can turn a team's attackers against their teammates.

cooldown_candidates.reason: Bailout availability determines whether an enemy can delay death and survive through a takedown.
Hostile Takeover availability strongly affects teamfight positioning and engagement timing.
Handshake availability determines her immediate root and displacement threat.
